(59)'phags pa sprin chen po'i mdo las char dbab pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde bar

tei:div.tei:p: (59)'phags pa sprin chen po'i mdo las char dbab pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// bde bar gshegs pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// rnam snang snying po can gyi sprin chen dang*// klu rigs las byung sprin gyis rnam par mdzes// sprin gyi chu 'dzin dpal ldan sprin gyi gze// sprin byung sprin gyi dkyil 'khor rnam 'joms sprin// nam mkha' dpag med sprin chen glog 'bar tshogs// sprin chen mthu rtsal dpa' dang sprin mdzes dang*// sprin sdud chen po sprin gyi dkyil 'khor che// sprin 'od sprin chen seng ge sprin chen gdugs// blta sdug sprin chen dang ni sprin chen khebs// sprin las byung ba snang bar byed pa'i dal// phyogs bcu mtho 'gebs rnga dbyangs rab sgrogs dang*// sprin bsil mi dga' rab 'joms sgra zab sgrogs// sprin chen dpal dang gang ga'i chu sprin dang*// rtsal gyi sprin ltar dpa' dang 'brug sgra bsgrags// kun tu sprin ston rgya chen sprin dang ni// sprin 'dzag sprin ltar rnam sgrogs sprin ltar 'phags/(60)/sprin 'dra'i na bza' mnab dang sprin gyi gnas// sprin gyis lo tog skyed dang char gyi sprin// sprin phung rnam par rgyas dang sprin 'du mdzad// sprin chen utpal sprin chen spos kyi sku// sprin chen 'phags dang sprin chen dbang phyug dang*// sprin chen 'od mdzad dang ni sprin chen byin// sprin ltar rnam 'joms sprin gyi chu bo dang*// rin chen nor bu'i sprin 'dra sprin sdud dang*// dus min sprin dang lce 'bab rnam par 'joms// sprin chen lta bur nam mkha' mtho nas bsgrags// sprin chen sgra 'byin sprin chen char chu skyes/ snyems pa'i gzi brjid sgrub pa'i sprin dang ni// ro bro drug dang ldan pa'i chu chen sprin// chu 'thor sprin chen sprin chen rgya mtsho 'gengs// char med tshe na sprin gyis kun tu 'gebs// sprin gzugs mtha' yas dang ni sprin chen po// thams cad rnams sgrub 'dzam bu'i sprin gyi dpal// gzi brjid 'od mdzad sprin gyi 'od zer can// shākya seng ge dang ni klu dbang rgyal// de dag kun la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo//

tadyathā/ dhā ra ṇī dhā ra ṇī/ utta ra ṇi/ sam tiṣṭhi te/ bi dza ya barṇa (61)sadya pra ti dzñā sa ra ha/ dzñā na pa ti/ ud de pā da ni bi nā ma ni/ a bhi ṣiñtsa ni/ a bhi bya hā ra/ shu bha ba ti/ a dzi ma tu/ e hi ku ma nā la ni/ bā ha ha ra klai sha na/ dhu na pā paṃ/ sho dha ya margha na/ ni rā ti ka/ dharmā ta shuddha/ lo ka bi ti mi ra ra tsa sa/ du kha sha ma na sarba buddha a ba lo ka na a dhiṣṭhi te/ pradzña dzñā na bhe swa hā/ bcom ldan rnam snang ye shes rgya mtsho ldan/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ tadyathā/ ma hā dzñā nā/ a ba bha sa ni/ shrī te dzwa lakṣ+ma dṛṣṭa bi kra ma/ badzra saṃ ha ra ne/ sa ra ma bi rā dzaḥ nirma la gu ṇa ke tu surya pra bhe/ bi ma lāṅga yaṣṭi/ bha ra bha ra/ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra/ du du mbha/ ha na ha na/ ma hā pra bhe bi bhu ta ma hā mo ha aṃ dha ka re/ pradzñā gri shuddhe/ pa ri sū ra ṇa mai tri/ bi ra ma na skambha/ mai tri ma buddha re/ dzwa la dzwa la dzwa la dzwa la dzwa lā ma buddha re/ bodhyaṅga ku su me da sha ba la tsa ru ra bai shā radya/ aṣṭe da sha a be ni ka buddha dharme/ shuddha ma ti/ puṇḍ+ye rā shi/ shu kla dharma sa ma nwi ti/ ghambhi ri/ gambh-i ri/ bi ra dza ske/ bi ma lo/ bi she ṣa/ prā' ba te/ ni rā pra bhe dharme/ sarba lo ka dzyeṣṭha dzyeṣṭha/ ba ra pra ba re/ a nutta re/ a saṅge/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ shanta ma te/ shanta ma te/ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/ sa ra ma buddha nu mi te/ ma hā pradzñā pā ra mi te swa hā/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi bden pa yis/ char pa'i bar chad lnga po bsal bar bya/ sadya ya the dan/ sa ra sa ra/ si ri si ri/ su ru su su/ nā ga nāṃ/ dza ba dza ba/ dzi bi dzi b-i/ dzu bu dzu bu/ sangs rgyas bden pas klu chen dag tshur gshegs/ 'dzam bu gling 'dir char chen myur du phob/ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/

klu yi bdag po che rnams tshur gshegs shig /sangs rgyas bden pas gling 'dir char chen phob/ sa ra sa ra/ si ri si ri/ su ru su ru/ sangs rgyas bden pas klu rnams dgug par bya// tshad med bzhi dang rgyal ba sras bcas kyi// bden pa'i byin gyis klu rnams tshur gshegs la// dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dran par gyis/ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ chu dang sprin gyi chu/ (63)can lag 'gro'i g.yog /byams pas tshur gshegs dam chos dran par gyis/ gha ṭa gha ṭa// ghi ṭi ghi ṭi/ ghu ṭu ghu ṭu/ drag shul khro ba shugs chen dang ldan pa// dug chen lce 'byin can rnams byams pas gshegs// sangs rgyas bden pas gling 'dir char phob cig swa hā/ ka la ka la/ ki li ki li/ ku lu ku lu/ chu chen la gnas sprin chen bzhon pas 'gro// byams pa'i sems kyis gling 'dir char thong zhig /ra la ra la/ ri li ri li/ ru lu ru lu/ lag 'gro khyod rnams le lo gnyid med par// dus gsum de bzhin gshegs pa'i bden pa yis// gha ma gha ma/ ghi mi ghi mi/ ghu mu ghu mu swa hā/ byams pa'i sems kyis klu rnams thams cad dgug na ra na ra/ ni ri ni ri/ nu ru nu ru swa hā/ yon po sna tshogs mgo stong mig dmar ba// stobs chen lto 'phye che rnams dgug par bya// de bzhin (64)gshegs pa'i byin brlabs dran par gyis/ ga ṭa ga ṭa/ gu ṭu gu ṭu swa ha/ stobs dang pha rol gnon dang gzi brjid ni// thogs med ldan pa dag gis char phob cig /sha ra sha ra*/ shi ri shi ri/ shu ru shu ru swa hā/ kye kye/ klu rnams rigs dang cho rigs dran par gyis// tshangs dang brgya byin rgyal chen bzhi yi lha// klu brgyad rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong*/ dgra bcom rang rgyal sangs rgyas byang sems kyi// byin rlabs bden pas gling 'dir char phob cig swa hā// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin// mkha' lding mi'am ci dang lto 'phye che'i// bden pas gnod pa zhi dang sems can srung*// 'khrug pa sol la rgyu skar ma rung zlog

/byams pas char phob sdig pa zhi bar gyis// sems can tshim zhing sa 'dir char chen phob/ swa hā// char la sgrib pa lnga po yang dag zung*// mi rnams bden pas mi rnams yongs su srungs swa hā/ ka ra ka ra*/ ki ri ki ri/ ku ru ku ru/ da ra da ra/ di ri di ri/ du ru du ru/ na ṭa na ṭa/ ni ṭi ni ṭi/ nu ṭu nu ṭu/ shin tu mgyogs bzhugs sprin chen chu 'dzin ma// sprin dang sprin (65)chen ldan ma sprin gsal ma// sprin chen chu 'dzin sprin 'byung dus sprin ma// sprin gyi 'byung gnas sprin sgrogs sprin bzhugs ma/ sprin gyi cod pan sprin gyi phreng ba mnga'// sprin gyis rnams brgyan sprin bcibs sprin gnas ma// sprin gyi snying po'i sprin gyi ral pa can// sprin 'od ma dang sprin gyi 'khor ldan ma/ rgya chen sprin bzhugs mchod phyir sprin thogs ma/ ri sul bzhugs ma lo tog 'ongs sgrub ma/ bsil reg 'tshub ma chen mor spyod yul ma// klu chen rnam par rol bar mdzad ma dang*// bon skra bcud kyi len drug 'dzin mdzad ma// sangs rgyas bden pas gling 'dir char dbab gsol/ swa hā/ gha ra gha ra/ ghiri ghi ri/ ghu ru ghu ru/ ghi ri ni ghi ri ni/ ghu ma ghu ma ghu ma/ ghu ma ghu ma ghu ma/ ghu ma ghu ma ghu ma ri/ dbu dgu sprin phreng glog tshogs phreng ldan ma// lag gis 'gro ba thams cad 'dzin ma dang*// sprin 'dra'i na bza' mnab dang dug drag po// thams cad spyod yul (66)'brug sgrogs sgra sgrogs ma// sprin bkod bcibs dang klu tshogs la skul ma// sprin chen phreng ldan ma yi klu rnams la// ma bshol de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char phob bskur du gsol/ swa hā/ ya ra ya ra/ yi ri yi ri/ yu ru yu ru/ dza ra dza ra/ dzi ri dzi ri/ dzu ru dzu ru/ dzha ra dzha ra/ gu ru gu ru/ gu gu ru/ ga ṭa ga ṭa/ ha ra ha ra/ hi li hi li/

mu lu mu lu/ ta la ta la/ ti li ti li/ tu lu tu lu/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ghṛ hṇa ghṛ hṇa/ marna marna/ pra marna/ bra ba ra sha bighnāṃ/ mai tri yādzñā pa ya ti swa hā/ buddhe buddhe/ bu buddhe/ ha ra pā paṃ/ sarba satwā naṃ/ a dhiṣṭhe ya ba/ bye ma/ sarba buddhā nāṃ/ dha ri ni dha re/ shu bha ma ti/ gu ṇā gra pra ba ṇe/ ma hā dzñāe na la ge shu klu dharma sangya pa ti dzñāe/ ma hā yā nāe dhuṣṭhi trai lo ka dzyeṣṭha bha ga ba te/ budna mai tri/ ā pu ra ya sarba kṣe trā ni/ shu klo shu tā ma/ ba ra da te/ santa ra ba si ni/ dhu dhu re/ dhu dhu ru/ sha ma sha ma (67) shānata ma nā sī/ char gyi bgegs kun rnam par bsal bar gsol swa hā/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis// byams pa'i thugs kyis klu rnams yang dag bskul// klu rgyal g.yog mtha' yas pa rgya mtsho'i sprin// bkod pa'i gzi brjid dkyil 'khor gdugs lta'i rgyal// dga' bo nyer dga' rgya mtshom dros pa// gzi can chu lha 'jog po yul 'khor srung*// nor rgyas btang bzung sa srung nu ta dang*// gzi brjid dpal bzang glog phreng gtsug nor bu// gtsug na nor thogs snang ldan gtsug phud can// de sogs klu yi rgyal po thams cad la/ yang dag bskul lo char chen rab tu phob/ swa hā/ nā ge nā ge/ ma hā nā ge/ gho ra ma na se nā ga hrī dā ya/ du mā ku le/ u gro ro ṣe pra tsaṇḍa te je/ bi ṣo gre/ a ṣe bi she/ a hi go re/ kṛṣṇasing ga le/ tsañtsa le/ lo le dzi he/ ma hā pha ṇa ka re/ ka lā pā she rau dra bā si ni/ ṭu ṭu ma be gha na gha na/ shi ki ni/ ka na ka na/ ga ṇa ga ṇa/ bhā ga ṇa ga ṇī/ sa ra sa ra*/ si ri si ri/ su ru su ru/ bi sphūrdza na/ bhu ru bhu ru/ ma hā (68)bhe ge/ ma ṇi da re/ phi ri phi ri/ phu ru phu ru/ pha ra pha ra/ barṣa barṣa/ dza lā mū da re/ shambu shambu/ ba ta tu ṭu me me/ dhuṃ dhuṃ dhuṃ dhuṃ be/

me gha pra bhe me gha bha hi ni/ dha ka dha ka dha ka dhu dhumbe/ gha nā gha na/ shi ki ni/ ka na ka na/ ga ṇa ga ṇa/ dhā nā ga ga ne/ ni ra traṇṭu/ badzrad rka ri bhā nā dhi da ye/ ghu ma ghu ma/ ghu ma pa yā sti ka/ dzaṃ' gi ri bhu dzaṃ ga me/ bi kang saṅga ṭe/ gor bi phurdza ni/ bidzri mbha ne/ dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ byams pa'i thugs kyis klu rnams yan lag thams cad dgug /dzaṃ bu'i gling 'dir char chen rab tu phob// swa hā/ na maḥsarba budhe bhyaḥsiddhyantu manta pa da ni swa hā/

tshul 'di mtha' bzhi spros bral kun gsal ngogs// tshad med bzhi yi chu 'dzin rab dkrigs pas// legs gsungs bka' yi sgra brgya sgrogs pa las// phan bde'i gru char 'bebs phyir ma ṇis btus// dge'o// dge'o// dge'o//
